summary: SharonAI Holdings filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026 detailing a September 28, 2026 syndicated senior secured term loan facility entered by indirect Australian subsidiaries SAI AU No. 1 and No. 3 Pty Ltd as borrowers, with lenders, Global Loan Agency Services Australia as agent and security trustee. The facility provides up to US$356 million across a US$150 million Facility A tranche and US$206 million Facility B tranche, guaranteed by intermediate holding companies and, on a limited releasable basis, by the parent. Proceeds fund GPU and server acquisition supporting a customer compute contract. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
